scope: lit04: synthetic robustness and condition-dependent semantic invariance
review_type: Focused systematic search and methods-level evidence review; not an exhaustive field census

papers.title: Beyond Accuracy: Behavioral Testing of NLP Models with CheckList
papers.data_languages_labels: English sentiment, question-pair and reading-comprehension tasks; task labels and behavioral relations
papers.method_result: Capability-specific minimum-functionality, invariance and directional tests expose failures missed by aggregate accuracy.
papers.limitation: Template combinations do not establish coverage or normative validity; relation depends on task/capability.
papers.jep_applicability: Prior art for abundant invariance testing, including negation and roles. Adapt as criterion-indexed tests; never globally declare role swap invariant.
papers.inspection: Primary paper methods/results inspected; section-level evidence, not abstract-only
papers.gap_confidence: High confidence this is relevant prior art; no exhaustive-absence claim

papers.title: Evaluating Models' Local Decision Boundaries via Contrast Sets
papers.data_languages_labels: Ten NLP datasets; knowledgeable annotators minimally edit existing cases and relabel
papers.method_result: Model-blind local contrasts reveal brittle decision boundaries; knowledgeable dataset authors produce meaningful edits.
papers.limitation: Local edits sample a neighborhood, not the entire decision boundary. Task labels are not JEP ethical judgments.
papers.jep_applicability: Expert-reviewed local contrasts and no model-in-loop test selection are precedents; keep descendants in one source-family split.
papers.inspection: Primary paper methods/results inspected; section-level evidence, not abstract-only
papers.gap_confidence: High confidence this is relevant prior art; no exhaustive-absence claim

papers.title: An Investigation of the (In)effectiveness of Counterfactually Augmented Data
papers.data_languages_labels: English SNLI and BoolQ counterfactual datasets; annotated task labels; controlled perturbation types
papers.method_result: Theory and experiments show incomplete augmentation can suppress other robust features and impair unseen-perturbation transfer.
papers.limitation: Evidence comes from particular task/feature settings; it is not a universal argument against augmentation.
papers.jep_applicability: Strong counterevidence to 'max out invariants'. Hold out operator types and compare equal-size multi-operator versus narrow-operator augmentation.
papers.inspection: Primary paper methods/results inspected; section-level evidence, not abstract-only
papers.gap_confidence: High confidence this is relevant prior art; no exhaustive-absence claim

papers.title: Counterfactually-Augmented SNLI Training Data Does Not Yield Better Generalization Than Unaugmented Data
papers.data_languages_labels: English SNLI/CNLI, MNLI and diagnostic NLI tests; entailment labels
papers.method_result: RoBERTa comparisons with equal-size original training data find no generalization advantage for counterfactual augmentation; negation behavior can worsen.
papers.limitation: Does not exclude better augmentation selection or other domains; extra data and augmentation effects must be separated.
papers.jep_applicability: Control examples/tokens and expert effort. Compare ordinary labeled source data with synthetic additions at the same budget.
papers.inspection: Primary paper methods/results inspected; section-level evidence, not abstract-only
papers.gap_confidence: High confidence this is relevant prior art; no exhaustive-absence claim

papers.title: Polyjuice: Generating Counterfactuals for Explaining, Evaluating, and Improving Models
papers.data_languages_labels: English task-diverse perturbation corpus; generated controls and human application labels
papers.method_result: Controlled GPT-2 infilling generates diverse local edits; the same perturbation can change one task label and preserve another.
papers.limitation: Fluent, close text and control codes do not certify legal facts or ethical label validity.
papers.jep_applicability: Direct counterexample to claiming condition-dependent augmentation itself novel; use generator only as proposal engine, with separate annotation.
papers.inspection: Primary paper methods/results inspected; section-level evidence, not abstract-only
papers.gap_confidence: High confidence this is relevant prior art; no exhaustive-absence claim

papers.title: Tailor: Generating and Perturbing Text with Semantic Controls
papers.inspected_support: §2 semantic controls and generator; Tables 2 and 6
papers.data_languages_labels: English semantic-role controlled generation; NLI and HANS downstream evaluation
papers.method_result: Semantic-role controls support actor/patient, temporal and voice changes, including composition; downstream robustness improves in studied settings.
papers.limitation: Semantic-role parser and generator errors remain; NLI success does not establish legal meaning preservation.
papers.jep_applicability: Prior art for retained-agent passive and explicit role controls. Test role-preserving positives jointly with role-changing negatives.
papers.inspection: Primary paper methods/results inspected; section-level evidence, not abstract-only
papers.gap_confidence: High confidence this is relevant prior art; no exhaustive-absence claim

papers.title: Right for the Wrong Reasons: Diagnosing Syntactic Heuristics in Natural Language Inference
papers.data_languages_labels: English synthetic NLI; template-derived entailment/non-entailment labels
papers.method_result: Examples cross lexical-overlap, subsequence and constituent heuristics with true entailment to reveal shortcut reliance.
papers.limitation: Synthetic restricted grammar and vocabulary constrain external validity.
papers.jep_applicability: Use same-word role reversals, plausible actors/patients and controls for implausibility. Keyword-only baselines are essential.
papers.inspection: Primary paper methods/results inspected; section-level evidence, not abstract-only
papers.gap_confidence: High confidence this is relevant prior art; no exhaustive-absence claim

papers.title: PAWS-X: A Cross-lingual Adversarial Dataset for Paraphrase Identification
papers.data_languages_labels: English PAWS translated to French, Spanish, German, Chinese, Japanese and Korean; paraphrase labels
papers.method_result: Human-translated development/test and machine-translated training create multilingual high-overlap paraphrase challenges.
papers.limitation: Translation ambiguity and entity/meaning errors need validation; translated siblings are not independent observations.
papers.jep_applicability: Native Spanish JEP source is reference. A bilingual reviewer must check actor, patient, scope, evidentiality and temporal relations.
papers.inspection: Primary paper methods/results inspected; section-level evidence, not abstract-only
papers.gap_confidence: High confidence this is relevant prior art; no exhaustive-absence claim

papers.title: ALIGN-SIM: A Task-Free Test Bed for Evaluating and Interpreting Sentence Embeddings through Semantic Similarity Alignment
papers.data_languages_labels: English QQP, PAWS-Wiki, MRPC and Afin-derived tests; declared semantic expectations
papers.method_result: Embedding evaluation covers distinction, synonyms, antonym/paraphrase relations, negation-free paraphrases and word jumbling.
papers.limitation: Natural-expectation relations are not independent expert moral judgments; task-free claims do not cover competing criteria.
papers.jep_applicability: Direct prior art for semantic coherence/invariant-direction embedding tests. Novelty needs explicit JEP criteria and independent validation.
papers.inspection: Primary paper methods/results inspected; section-level evidence, not abstract-only
papers.gap_confidence: High confidence this is relevant prior art; no exhaustive-absence claim

papers.title: CoBA: Counterbias Text Augmentation for Mitigating Various Spurious Correlations via Semantic Triples
papers.data_languages_labels: English SNLI/MNLI and SST-2/IMDB; supervised task labels and bias evaluations
papers.method_result: Subject-predicate-object decomposition plus feature importance alters principal features while retaining spurious cues; reports robustness gains.
papers.limitation: Estimated feature importance is not causal truth; reconstruction/deletion can remove legally decisive facts.
papers.jep_applicability: Triple-based augmentation is existing work. Authority, status or place cannot be presumed spurious in Colombian legal narratives.
papers.inspection: Primary paper methods/results inspected; section-level evidence, not abstract-only
papers.gap_confidence: High confidence this is relevant prior art; no exhaustive-absence claim

papers.title: Leveraging Variation Theory in Counterfactual Data Augmentation for Optimized Active Learning
papers.data_languages_labels: Yelp, MASSIVE and Emotions classification subsets; original labels plus generator-assigned target labels
papers.method_result: Pattern-controlled generation varies one dimension while preserving others; filters and active-learning comparisons show greatest gains at low annotation counts.
papers.limitation: LLM discrimination is not independent human validation; gains diminish with more labels and depend on filtering.
papers.jep_applicability: Direct prior art for holding all but one aspect fixed. Compare review cost and independent validity, not generated volume alone.
papers.inspection: Primary paper methods/results inspected; section-level evidence, not abstract-only
papers.gap_confidence: High confidence this is relevant prior art; no exhaustive-absence claim

papers.title: Enhancing Negation Awareness in Universal Text Embeddings: A Data-efficient and Computational-efficient Approach
papers.data_languages_labels: English STS-B with automatic negation; semantic/antonym/negation evaluations; synthetic expectations
papers.method_result: Frozen-embedding feature reweighting improves negation sensitivity with a tradeoff in ordinary semantic similarity.
papers.limitation: Preprint version inspected; generated negations and evaluation construction limit claims; not JEP judgments.
papers.jep_applicability: Negation-aware lightweight geometry is prior work. Scope-sensitive weighting and unknown-versus-negative separation need domain validation.
papers.inspection: Primary paper methods/results inspected; section-level evidence, not abstract-only
papers.gap_confidence: High confidence this is relevant prior art; no exhaustive-absence claim

exclusions.title: ConSERT (Yan et al., 2021)
exclusions.reason: Methods inspected as background; token/dropout augmentation is less domain-specific than the 12 retained studies; no claim semantic preservation is proved.

exclusions.title: Large Model Semantic Parsing of Court Records with Bias Calibration Benchmark for Restorative Justice
exclusions.reason: Publisher primary landing page inspected only; methods/PDF and reproducible artifacts not verified. Published 18 December 2025 despite 2026 DOI suffix; data available on request. Retain as novelty-warning lead, not verified quantitative evidence.

exclusions.title: Secondary summaries, ResearchGate mirrors and generic augmentation surveys
exclusions.reason: Excluded from evidentiary core when a primary paper was available.

augmentation_contract.status: Proposed next-benchmark specification; no human labels claimed
augmentation_contract.unit: Source family, with all descendants and translations assigned together

operators.rule: Change active/passive voice while retaining explicit actor, patient, modality, negation, attribution and time.
operators.relation: invariant only when semantic-role and evidential checks pass
operators.review: bilingual semantic review for benchmark cases

operators.rule: Apply a bijection to non-identifying names; preserve all coreference and social/legal roles.
operators.relation: invariant only for declared identity-irrelevant criterion
operators.review: expert check identity is not legally or collectively relevant

operators.rule: Swap who acts and who experiences effects, retaining plausible event.
operators.relation: sensitive for responsibility; potentially invariant for stipulated unweighted aggregate harm only

operators.rule: Toggle one explicit proposition; record exact scope and preserve all others.
operators.relation: criterion-dependent sensitive or directional; never globally antonymic distance

operators.rule: Remove whether an event occurred or who performed it; mark unknown.
operators.relation: unknown, not harmless/false/zero; evaluate epistemic discrimination or abstention
operators.review: human check omission does not imply negation

operators.rule: Contrast allegation, admission, judicial finding, denial and retraction with explicit source.
operators.relation: epistemic change; topical similarity may persist, evidential retrieval should respond

operators.rule: Keep positive wording fixed while changing whose harm a measure addresses, adequacy, consent or completion.
operators.relation: sensitive for restoration adequacy; no universal harm/reparation vector inverse

operators.rule: Translate Spanish meaning preserving roles, negation, evidentiality, time and culturally specific harm; retain original.
operators.review: bilingual review required; automatic backtranslation is a flag, not certification

human_required: legal role relevance and epistemic interpretation
independent stratified validity sample of generator outputs
metrics: family-bootstrap retrieval MRR/Recall with independent relevance labels
invariance score drift and rank agreement
training_controls: condition-aware positives plus semantic hard negatives
no test examples used for prompt/model selection
dev-only thresholds and frozen pre-test specification

gap.claim: An independently expert-validated Spanish JEP benchmark of joint criterion-dependent invariance and sensitivity, epistemic-status preservation and unseen-operator/source-family transfer is a promising empirical contribution.
gap.confidence: Moderate for useful empirical gap; low for global novelty until specialist legal/Spanish/JEP literature and adjacent restorative paper are checked.
non_novel: vary one semantic dimension while holding others fixed
gap.decisive_experiment: Freeze a source-family test with expert-adjudicated contrasting criteria. Compare recovered conditional Qwen with unconditioned/base model and lightweight heads; train balanced condition-aware augmentation versus equal-budget natural labels and narrow-operator augmentation. Report joint invariant/sensitive success and retrieval with family uncertainty, including Spanish, unknown-status and unseen-operator slices. Failure of independent validity or transfer is a revise result, not a reason to tune on held-out cases.
